collision._note: Heroes.checkWall / horizontalWall / angledWall / verticalWall, RECONSTRUCTION 3.5. Each tick, per hero, the test point is the hero's position plus heroSize x probe, raised by probeLift. A wall within reach x |velocity| on the axis it blocks sets that velocity to +/-push, away from the wall to the side the point is on; within angledStop of an angled wall's line the hero's x velocity is zeroed too.
